events.title: [Teens Takeover | arts] Blue Mosque Art Cart: Beginner Chinese Calligraphy Workshop
events.age_note: This programme is suitable for teens aged 13 to 17.
events.description: Lim Tze Peng is known for his nostalgic depictions of Singapore captured via ink paintings and Chinese calligraphy. Untitled (Blue Mosque) (c. Late 1970s) presents Lim’s interpretation of Sultan Mosque and its surrounding areas, located in the Kampong Glam district today. While the mosque is no longer blue, the artwork reflects a culmination of his memories of the mosque from the 1950s to 1960s.

registration.note: Registration is required. There are 10 seats available.
